parsed.post: Discarding my latest experiment (1.0340) as it regressed from my best (1.0230). It seems increasing the learning rate to 0.04 was too much for this config. Reverting to f73da90. Next: testing MATRIX_LR 0.05 with WARMUP_RATIO 0.1 and WEIGHT_DECAY 0.1 to see if we can find a better sweet spot.
parsed.description: Testing a slight increase in learning rate to 0.05 while maintaining high warmup (0.1) and weight decay (0.1) for stability.
